title: Verify circuit features match RF baseline; find minimum MLP architecture
context: CRITICAL DISCOVERY: The 95.74% RF accuracy was achieved on DIGITAL-STYLE Python features (ratios, normalized values, energy), but the analog circuits compute DIFFERENT mathematical operations (amplified differences, raw voltage samples). The 8->64->5 MLP only reached 79.78% on the digital features; the MLP architecture is too small. Running a comprehensive sweep of 11 MLP architectures on BOTH feature sets to find (a) whether circuit-matching features achieve similar RF accuracy, and (b) the minimum MLP size for >95% accuracy.

key_findings.finding: Feature definition mismatch between Python and circuits
key_findings.detail: Python rr_ratio = pre_rr/local_rr (RATIO). Circuit F1 = sf_out - ewma (DIFFERENCE). Python beat_instability = |pk-prev|/prev (NORMALIZED). Circuit F3 = pk - prev_pk (RAW DIFF). Python pwave_energy = sum(filtered^2)/fs (ENERGY). Circuit F5 = ECG@mid - ECG@start (VOLTAGE DIFF). Python qrs_width = threshold crossing ms (WIDTH). Circuit F6 = ECG@R+83ms (RAW SAMPLE). Similar mismatch for F2, F7, F8.
key_findings.impact: The 95.74% RF accuracy is on digital-style features, not on what circuits produce. Must verify circuit-matching features achieve similar accuracy.

key_findings.detail: RF(300 trees, depth 15) = 95.74% on 8 digital features. MLP(8->64->5 no BN) = 79.78% on same features. Gap = 15.96%. The single 64-neuron hidden layer cannot learn the decision boundaries.
key_findings.impact: Even with perfect circuits, the 8->64->5 analog MLP cannot reach 96%.

key_findings.detail: Analog emulation MLP showed 57.68% (22% drop), but transfer functions built from only 6 records. True circuit degradation unknown.
key_findings.impact: Need actual ngspice validation, not extrapolation from 6 records.

success_criteria.metric: Minimum MLP architecture for >95% on circuit features
success_criteria.target: Identify smallest [layers] achieving >95% with S>=50%, V>=85%
success_criteria.current_value: PENDING — 11 architectures x 2 feature sets x 3 seeds running

decision_tree: IF circuit RF >= 93%: Circuit features work. Need bigger MLP — determine minimum size for ReRAM crossbar feasibility.
IF circuit RF < 85%: Circuit features are too lossy. Must redesign circuits to compute ratios (requires analog divider) or energy (requires squarer+integrator).
IF best MLP > 256 neurons total: May exceed ReRAM crossbar capacity. Need to discuss fabrication constraints.
IF MLP 128->64 or smaller achieves >95%: Feasible on ReRAM. Redesign analog classifier.
